title: System Overlay
concept: Five-step sequence so hard conversations produce outcomes: Warmth → Safety → Expression → Request → Alignment.
whenToUse: Any sensitive discussion, change request, rupture repair, or joint decision. Use as diagnostic when stuck, circular, or escalated.
steps: Warmth — warmest true sentence; same team.
Safety — Green Rule; relationship not threatened in this moment.
Expression — impact with ownership (what → felt → meant).
Request — one specific, actionable, time-bound ask.
Alignment — who does what by when + review.

phrases.text: I love us, and I’m not trying to fight.
When X happened, I felt Y; the impact was Z.
Can we try ___ this week and check in on ___?

working: Warmth → Safety → “When you scrolled while I talked, I felt dismissed; I shut down.” Request: 10 minutes device-free at night. Alignment: try this week; check Sunday.
notWorking: Jump to rules: “No phones at night — it’s rude.” Without Warmth/Safety/owned Expression, listener hears control; fight becomes always/never.
activity: 12-minute drill: low-stakes topic; five labelled lines; listener protects sequence. Aim 2% better, not perfect.
